name: haidian_submission_review
description: 百年京张AI创新带方案提交审查流程 — 二层门禁：格式自检 + 质量审查

steps.name: scaffold
steps.description: 运行 scaffold_ai_submission.py 创建目录结构

steps.name: generate
steps.description: Generator Subagent 生成方案包全部内容（proposal.md + GeoJSON + 图纸 + matrices + HTML + PDF）

steps.name: self_check
steps.description: 运行 self_check_submission.py → 全部 PASS 则进入 finalize，否则回到 generate

steps.name: repair_format
steps.description: 修复格式错误（missing files / topology / hash mismatch）→ 重新 self_check

steps.name: finalize
steps.description: 运行 finalize_submission.py 锁包（刷新 manifest hashes、设置 package_state=ready_for_review）

steps.name: panel_review
steps.description: 7 法官并行审查 → 统计 verdict → 路由决策

steps.name: repair_content
steps.description: Generator 按 findings 增量修复内容（不改结构）→ 重新 finalize + panel_review

steps.name: completed
steps.description: 方案通过！输出最终评审报告，准备 PR

steps.name: human_escalation
steps.description: 存在 blocking 违规或连续 stall，需要人工决策

routing_rules.panel_review → minor_fixes: ≥5/7 Not Refuted 但有 non-blocking 的 Refuted（通常 figure_quality）
routing_rules.panel_review → blocking: 任何 blocking=true 的 Refuted（compliance 底线或 package_integrity 不通过）
